citations.quote: my son's cough, which has not gone away since the summer, is something his doctor puts down to the mould in the room where he sleeps.
There is also mould behind the wardrobe in the bedroom, which has started to creep along the ceiling
The underfloor heating in the living area stopped working completely at the end of September.
Mrs Messerli says the heating engineer is "booked up".
LEASE AGREEMENT FOR RESIDENTIAL PREMISES – page 1 of 4

plan.because: Request the complete lease; page 1 does not establish all agreed tenancy terms.
Obtain the report identifying the defects and when they were reported.
Establish whether and when the landlord received the defect report.
Obtain dated photographs showing the affected locations and visible defects.
Obtain the landlord's responses, proposed work and access arrangements.
Mould is reported; dated moisture and temperature observations are relevant.
A heating fault is reported; obtain any inspection and service findings.
Health effects are reported; obtain the medical findings and any limits on attributed cause.
A separate technical inspection need is not mentioned and is presumed absent for planning; the booked heating engineer does not establish that need.
An official rent deposit is not mentioned and is presumed not considered for planning. Asking about a repair deadline alone does not activate that branch.
This document is optional under the process.

questions: Is your son currently experiencing urgent or worsening symptoms, or is the heating failure creating an immediate safety risk? Seek prompt medical or emergency help if needed.
When and how did you notify the landlord of each defect, and what responses or access arrangements followed?
Have a heating engineer or another specialist inspected the property? If so, is a report available?
